name: Abijam
overview: Abijam, also known as Abijah or Abia, was a king of Judah who reigned for three years in Jerusalem following the death of his father Rehoboam. Scripture records that he followed in the sinful ways of his father and did not have a heart fully devoted to the Lord as David did. Nonetheless, God preserved his dynasty for David's sake, ensuring that Abijam's son Asa would succeed him and continue the establishment of Jerusalem.
